descriptionChirho: To fall off or drop away physically, as of chains falling from hands or flowers falling from a plant (Acts 12:7; Jas 1:11; 1Pet 1:24)
To run aground or be driven off course in a nautical context, as a ship driven onto rocks or reefs (Acts 27:17,26,29,32)
To fall away from grace, faith, or moral steadfastness in a spiritual or metaphorical sense (Gal 5:4; 2Pet 3:17)
To fail or become void, said of divine promises or words that do not lose their power or effectiveness (Rom 9:6)
